contract.name: Reservation Contract Winter 2026/27 (1 Nov 2026 – 30 Apr 2027)
contract.tax_note: All quoted rates include any applicable tax in force at the time of signature of this agreement; an increase of any applicable indirect tax after signing (or a new tax, levy or charge) is added as applicable by law.
contract.child_policy_text: Child below 11.99 years (between 5 – 11.99 y) will be charged 50% of the per person rate including extra bed on the booked basis. Child below 4.99 y: FOC (sharing parents' accommodation). Children above 12 years are considered adults.
contract.cancellation_text: 30 days or more: No cancellation fee. 29 – 21 days prior to arrival: 75% cancellation fee. 20 – 0 days prior to arrival: 100% cancellation fee.
contract.terms_text: Rates are subject to changes with government tax policy. Twin rooms are limited and subject to availability. Please mention the applicable special rate at the time of reservation; special rates are not valid for existing reservations or re-booking. The resort reserves the right to end the special offer within 3 working days. All reservations must be sent to the designated reservation e-mail IDs provided, unless otherwise specified. The agency cannot assign or grant any rights in this contract to third parties without written consent from the hotel. Non-distribution to other non-retail travel agencies (Spain reserved for the hotel / BGH). These rates are not valid until the signature of the contract.
contract.notes: Rates printed HB only, per room. BB = HB − USD 5 per person (printed "Bed & Breakfast reduction per person USD 05"); FB = HB + lunch USD 20 per person. The last period is printed "01st Apr 2027 – 31st Apr 2027" — entered to 30 Apr 2027 (the contract duration end). Maximum occupancy: Deluxe 2AD / 3AD / 2AD + 1 child sharing parents bed (6 twins). No group payment terms printed. Contacts: general line +94 66 228 6299 (also +94 47 567 7623); General Manager Udesh Sasanka +94 76 368 6839, udesh.sasanka@ekhohotels.com; corporate reservations +94 117 765 555 / +94 772 387 777, reservations@ekhohotels.com.
